niche_preference_profile: This user consistently prefers light, neutral interfaces with soft pastel accents, clear hierarchy, compact and well-organized content structure, explicit text-labeled actions, restrained visual emphasis, and low-clutter presentation. They favor contained icons or trust cues, flatter styling with minimal shadow, and layouts that make actions and information easy to scan without harsh contrast or oversized decorative elements.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light neutral backgrounds and soft gray or white surfaces with subtle pastel accents, especially purple or pink, and rejects dark high-contrast themes with intense electric accents.
Prefers organized sections, aligned content, clear labels, prominent headings, and strong hierarchy that makes information easy to scan and understand.
Prefers compact rows or neatly grouped content with efficient spacing and organized alignment rather than bulky cards, oversized elements, or loose structure.
Prefers muted, selective accent usage and lower-pressure button styling over vivid, highly emphasized buttons or strong accent colors used aggressively.
Prefers clearly styled inputs, prominent but understandable primary actions, and text-labeled controls or guidance instead of ambiguous icon-only actions or weak affordances.
Prefers simpler compositions with fewer layered containers, minimal shadows, and flatter presentation that keeps attention on the main task.
Prefers small contained icons or soft-badge trust cues that support the interface without dominating it, and rejects oversized or overly bold icon treatment.
